_readme: The guest push catalogue for open matches (build contracts §1.9, R3; docs/design/open-matches/guest.md §4.7), tournaments (docs/design/tournaments/build-contracts-2026-10-03.md §1.10) and coaching (§1.9 of docs/design/coaching/build-contracts-2026-10-01.md; docs/design/coaching/guest.md §4.6). ONE list for five copies: send-push (a guest kind reads its copy by title_key from send-push/guestStrings.ts, and a row whose kind is not its title key's kind, or whose route is not listed here, is terminal), app.match_notify (c_keys, 0261: the keys of the three match kinds; packages/db/tests/guest-push.test.ts compares), app.lesson_notify (c_keys, lesson_booking: the keys of the three lesson kinds; packages/db/tests/lesson-push.test.ts compares), app.tournament_notify (c_keys, tournaments_lifecycle: the keys of tournament_update; packages/db/tests/tournaments-lifecycle.test.ts compares), and apps/mobile/src/features/matches/pushRoutes.ts (routes and kinds). Each notify function validates only its own params. title_keys maps each key to the one kind it is queued under. Params are closed to the names below: no name and no amount ever reaches a lock screen. Deno cannot import a workspace package, so this JSON is the shared artefact, as staff-push.json is. Add a key here, in guestStrings.ts (EN and AR) and in its notify function in the same change, and deploy send-push before a migration can queue it.
